given: a warehouse operator viewing a stock row whose batch_number and serial_number are null (a code that did not parse during the migration)
when: the row renders in the stock list or detail
then: each field shows a clear empty / not-tracked indication rather than a blank guessed value or a reconstructed combined code

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover rows/forms with populated values; this AC covers the null render. A UI that displays populated batch/serial correctly could still render nulls as blank or a stray combined code, passing the prior ACs but failing here, so the null-state experience is independently breakable.
